block.claim: Red 5x5 block sits in cell(5,0) blocking the only route. Red line runs from block along row40 to col40 up to 3x3 plug at cell(0,4). Player cannot move onto any red cell (DOWN blocked from (4,0) and (0,4)).

maze.claim: Level1 maze: 8x6 cells (stride 6px, cell(i,j) interior rows 8+6i..12+6i, cols 14+6j..18+6j). Free: row0 c0-4, (1,0),(1,2),(2,0..2), col0 rows3-6, row7 c0-5. Only route start(0,0)->ring(7,5) passes (5,0).

plug.claim: Standing on plug cell(0,4) absorbs plug -> line shortens 1 cell -> block advances to (5,1), freeing (5,0). Leaving plug cell reverts everything immediately. SPACE = respawn player to (0,0) + full revert.
